user_query: I want to create a sports website that covers transfer news, latest transfers, and player market value.

TaskList.description: Access the transfer records API to retrieve information about transfers, including player details and trade value.
Process the data retrieved from the transfer records API to display the latest transfers and player market values on the website.
Access the game plans API to retrieve information about ongoing and upcoming games.
Access the competitions API to retrieve short information about the competitions related to the games.
Integrate the game plans and competitions data into the website to provide users with comprehensive coverage.
